versions.content: No New Data extension factor calculation The calculated no new data extension factor shall be: • RteComDataE2EXfNNDExtensionFactor , before the first execution of E2EXf_Inv_<transformerId> for this VariableDataPrototype . • 1, if the last execution of E2EXf_Inv_<transformerId> for this VariableDataPrototype did not return E_OK , E_SAFETY_INIT_OK , E_SAFETY_INVALID_OK , E_SAFETY_NOSM_OK or E_SAFETY_NODATA_OK . • RteComDataE2EXfNNDExtensionFactor , if the last execution of E2EXf_Inv_<transformerId> for this VariableDataPrototype re- turned E_SAFETY_E_OK , E_SAFETY_INIT_OK , E_SAFETY_INVALID_OK , E_SAFETY_NOSM_OK or E_SAFETY_NODATA_OK .
